name: SKYCOT brand assets
source: docs/brand/narrowing/2026-10-22 (Direction B, variants 1-3); master drawing reused unchanged

system.day: Variant 1 - blue morning sky, sticker mascot. Default; local civil dawn to dusk.
system.dusk: Variant 2 - twilight sky + star. Local civil dusk to dawn; system Dark icon.
system.minimal: Variant 3 - one-colour cloud with eye cut-outs. Mono, menu bar, <=16px, Clear/Tinted, embroidery, grown-up lockup.

characterName: SKYCOT (the cloud shares the product name; files use 'mascot' by design)
